title: Olive Finds the Trail
note: b418 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes eigh, ei, ey.

pages.brief: Olive the owl perched on a low branch at dusk, looking down at a row of small wet marks on a stone garden path.
Olive the owl lifting one foot and looking closely at her own grey foot, comparing it with the wet marks on the path below.
Olive the owl tilting her head, her amber eyes following the line of wet marks along the stone path.
Olive the owl swooping low over the garden path, grey wings spread wide, eyes fixed on the trail of marks below.
A trail of small wet marks on a stone path, running past the thick brown trunk of a big oak tree.
A trail of small wet marks on a stone path, running past the open doorway of an old wooden barn.
A row of small wet marks on a stone path, ending at the grassy edge of a round blue garden pond.
Ned the duckling popping up out of a round blue pond with a splash, water drops flying off his yellow-brown feathers.
A close view of Ned the duckling standing on the grassy bank, his wet orange feet matching the shape of the marks on the path.
Olive the owl and Ned the duckling standing together by the round pond, both grinning at the trail of wet marks on the path.
